title: Modified function formatPrice to round to the nearest cent
context: A price with a fraction of a cent is rounded to the nearest cent. It was cut down to the cent below before.
- `formatPrice` in `src/lib/format.ts` rounds `priceCents` with `Math.round`. It used `Math.floor` before. One line changes, inside the function.
- `ProductCard` calls `formatPrice` for the price of a product, so the catalogue page shows the new rounding.
- `CartLine` calls it for the total of a line and `CartSummary` for the total of the cart, so the cart page shows it too.
- The account page does not format a price and is not reached.

files.title: Price formatting
summary: `formatPrice` rounds to the nearest cent. It rounded down before.

waypoints.title: Round to the nearest cent
waypoints.reading: `Math.floor` became `Math.round`. Every caller passes a whole number of cents today, so nothing on screen changes. An amount with a fraction, such as a discounted price, would now go up from half a cent instead of always going down.
